test_reformer_local_attn_model: run the ReformerLocalAttnModelTest suite to test Reformer model with local attention layers
test_reformer_lsh_attn_model: run the ReformerLSHAttnModelTest suite to test Reformer model with LSH attention layers
test_reformer_integration: run the ReformerIntegrationTests to verify layer activations and gradients against expected outputs
test_reformer_model_tester: use ReformerModelTester to create config and input tensors for testing Reformer variants
test_reformer_tester_mixin: use ReformerTesterMixin to share common test methods across local and LSH attention test classes
